items.title: The RealReal won’t let AI agents hog designer clothing
items.excerpt: AI agents could break even the most unexpected parts of the web.

items.title: Google Sells Itself As A Commerce 'Matchmaker,' Not A Retailer
items.excerpt: The search giant wants to control how people discover new brands.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads With Learn More Arrow Link - Some Through Amazon DSP
items.excerpt: OpenAI seems to be rolling out a new ad format for some ChatGPT Ad units that have a Learn more link, that is dotted and underlined, and also with an arrow going upwards.  And in some cases, ChatGPT Ads seem to be served with Amazon DSP.

items.title: Google Ads 1-Click AI Max Experiment
items.excerpt: Google Ads updated its frequently asked questions page for AI Max search campaigns with a section on 1-click AI Max experiments. Google wrote in the document, "If your account is eligible, you may find a 1-click experiment recommendation on your Recommendations page."

items.title: The Daily Mail tests GEO with brands ahead of AI visibility product
items.excerpt: The Daily Mail is running around a dozen GEO tests before turning its AI visibility offering into an official product next year.

items.title: Etsy forces sellers to show one unaltered photo in every listing
items.excerpt: Bot-generated listings and AI-made patterns or recipes are now barred for nearly 6 million sellers. Removals of violating listings expand in the coming months.

items.title: Hidden reading-app clicks ran nearly 25x above other traffic, IAS says
items.excerpt: Desktop apps refreshed ads on locked screens; Genisys ran through nearly 500 AI-made domains. IAS's October 21 recap adds no new data. What did it leave out?

items.title: Google Ads search terms report adds 4 source columns for AI Max traffic
items.excerpt: Match, landing page, headline and description sources now sit beside each search term for AI Max campaigns. Google's help page does not yet list the columns.

items.title: Why Clorox shifted from creating brand campaigns to systems of relevance
items.excerpt: CMO Eric Schwartz dug into Pine-Sol, Brita and Hidden Valley marketing that prioritized “intentional but flexible” and “insightful but bite-sized” efforts.

items.title: B2B Buying Decisions Are Moving Where Ad Tech Can’t See
items.excerpt: As B2B buying shifts toward AI-assisted research, private peer conversations and dark social sharing, buyers become invisible to our measurement solutions.

items.title: ChatGPT Rarely Named Some Brands Even When Sources Mentioned Them
items.excerpt: Brands logged-out ChatGPT rarely named without search also showed up less when it searched, even with cited-page coverage, in new comparison-prompt data.

items.title: 150만개 상품 속 ‘내 팀 코디’ 찾는다…파나틱스, 오픈AI와 맞손

items.title: AI 큐레이터가 상품 추천 …롯데 칼리버스·백화점, 시시호시 협업
items.excerpt: 롯데이노베이트 자회사 칼리버스가 AI 큐레이션과 몰입형 쇼핑 경험을 결합해 유통 분야 인공지능 전환(AX)에 속도를 낸다. 패션·가전·스포츠에 이어 라이프스타일까지 적용 범위를 넓히며 롯데 유통 계열사와의 협업을 확대하고 있다. 칼리버스는 롯데백화점의 라이프스타일 편집숍 '시시호시(SISIHOSI)'와 협업해 롯데백화점몰 모바일 앱에 '시시호시 이머시브 스토어'를 선보였다고 27일 밝혔다. 지난 7월 첫 서비스를 시작한 이후 네 번째 협업 사례

items.title: 뉴엔AI, 넷플릭스코리아와 브랜드 파트너십 성과 분석에 '맞손'
